messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: Smart-routing failure affecting model tool-calls in eu-west-1. 90% error rate when routing to fallback variant. Severity: high. @Anna (oncall) paged.

Anna (oncall): I'm on it. summary? symptoms?

Max: Customers started reporting missing tool-call attachments and 500s around 09:03 UTC. Tracing shows requests routed to `redwood-model-3b-quant` which returns a compatibility error: 'unsupported_feature: tool_calling'.

Sara: That variant should have been registered as tool_calling=false in the compatibility matrix. It looks like a stale manifest marked it as true. 

Jorge: Which routing policy caused route to pick the quant variant? Smart-routing fallback was allowed to pick any compatible region/variant. The policy had an accidental `allow_toolcall_fallback: true` override.

Alyssa: Customer impact: 5 enterprise tenants in eu-west-1, spike in error rate -> some users unable to complete bot flows. CS getting escalations.

Anna (oncall): Initial mitigation: pause smart-routing fallback in eu-west-1, route to primary fp16 pool only. Can someone flip the policy flag? I don't want a full deploy if possible.

Max: On it. Running hotfix: 
```
# block fallback to quant variants in eu-west-1
redis-cli HSET routing:policies:eu-west-1 allow_quant_fallback 0
```
Doing now.

deploy-bot: deploy accepted: redis write OK (txn id 9832f).

Sara: Confirming router configs pick up change. Forcing config reload on edge-router-4: `systemctl reload redwood-router`

Max: Reloaded. Observability: error-rate dropped from 92% to 8% within 18s. Tool-call failures dropped to baseline. :relieved:

Jorge: Good. We need to fix the compatibility matrix entry for `redwood-model-3b-quant`. Where is manifest stored?

Sara: Manifests live in model-registry service. Quick fix: update `features.tool_calling=false` for that variant, and bump manifest version. I'll open a patch.

Sara: Patch PR: `gitlab.com/redwood/model-registry!12345` — updating manifest + adding CI lint rule to prevent tool_calling=true for quant variants without validation.

Alyssa: Ops note for CS: send interim note to impacted customers: "We mitigated a routing issue where a quantized model was incorrectly marked as supporting tool calls. We've routed traffic to compatible variants and are patching manifests. No data loss; requests retried automatically." I can draft a message.

Anna (oncall): Handing off to Max (next oncall) in 30 mins. Document remediation steps and the rollback plan in the incident doc.

Max: Writing runbook items: 1) disable quant fallback in region; 2) reload routers; 3) update manifest + CI; 4) monitor 5xx and tool-call error metric for 2 hours; 5) schedule a follow-up RCA.

deploy-bot: PR merged and model-registry version bumped to `v2026-03-15-1843`.

Sara: Follow-up: adding an automated compatibility verifier to model onboarding pipeline that checks feature support across quant/fp16/int8. This should prevent variant matrix divergence.

Jorge: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~12k failed tool-call attempts across 5 tenants during window 09:03–09:12 UTC; automatic retries resolved most once routing changed. No SSO/data exfiltration.

Alyssa: Draft sent to CS for review, will go out after legal signs off.

Anna (oncall): Thanks team. I'm switching the pager to Max in 25m. Leaving incident open for RCA until tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
